#### 2. Cập nhật `public/ar-runtime.js`

Tôi đã điều chỉnh lại thuật toán tìm video. Ở A-Frame 1.2.0, AR.js thường đặt ID là `arjs-video`.

```javascript
// ar-runtime.js
(function() {
    console.log("[AR-Runtime] 🚀 Initializing in Iframe...");

    const debugOverlay = document.getElementById('debug-overlay');
    function log(msg) {
        console.log(`[AR-Runtime] ${msg}`);
        if(debugOverlay) debugOverlay.innerText = msg;
    }

    // Gửi tin nhắn về React Parent
    function sendToParent(type, payload = {}) {
        window.parent.postMessage({ type, payload }, '*');
    }

    // Hàm cưỡng chế tìm và xử lý Video Element
    function forceVideoSetup() {
        // Tìm thẻ video do AR.js tạo ra (thường có id 'arjs-video' hoặc chỉ là thẻ video đầu tiên)
        const video = document.getElementById('arjs-video') || document.querySelector('video');

        if (!video) {
            log("⏳ Waiting for AR.js video element...");
            requestAnimationFrame(forceVideoSetup);
            return;
        }

        log("✅ Video element found!");
        
        // Fix lỗi màn hình đen: Ép play video nếu nó bị pause
        if (video.paused) {
            video.play().then(() => log("▶️ Video playing forced")).catch(e => log("⚠️ Play error: " + e));
        }

        // Ép style để chắc chắn nó hiện lên
        video.style.position = "absolute";
        video.style.top = "0";
        video.style.left = "0";
        video.style.width = "100%";
        video.style.height = "100%";
        video.style.zIndex = "-999";
        video.style.objectFit = "cover";

        // Báo cho React biết đã sẵn sàng
        sendToParent('AR_READY', { initialized: true });
    }

    // Lắng nghe sự kiện A-Frame scene loaded
    const scene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    if (scene) {
        scene.addEventListener('loaded', () => {
            log("🎬 A-Frame Scene loaded. Looking for video...");
            forceVideoSetup();
        });
    }

    // Fallback: Nếu scene load quá nhanh hoặc event bị miss
    setTimeout(forceVideoSetup, 2000);

    // Lắng nghe lệnh từ React
    window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        const { type, payload } = event.data;
        if (type === 'AR_SET_DEBUG') {
            if (payload.enabled) {
                if(debugOverlay) debugOverlay.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
    });
})();

```

<style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/Overlays.css">/* ============================================================
   QUIZ & GAME RESPONSIVE OVERLAY
   Mobile-first design matching ARScene
   ============================================================ */

/* Base overlay container */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Content wrapper - responsive padding */
.quiz-overlay > div,
.game-overlay > div {
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

/* Card/Panel responsive sizing */
.quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.game-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.quiz-overlay .bg-white,
.game-overlay .bg-white {
  max-width: 90vw !important;
  max-height: 85vh !important;
  max-height: 85dvh !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Buttons responsive */
.quiz-overlay button,
.game-overlay button {
  min-height: 44px; /* iOS touch target */
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
}

/* Text responsive */
.quiz-overlay .text-xl,
.game-overlay .text-xl {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-2xl,
.game-overlay .text-2xl {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.5rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-6xl,
.game-overlay .text-6xl {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4rem);
}

/* Mobile optimizations */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* Game cards grid */
  .game-overlay .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }

  /* Game card sizing */
  .game-overlay .w-24,
  .game-overlay .h-24 {
    width: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
    height: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
  }

  /* Quiz options */
  .quiz-overlay .space-y-3 {
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }
}

/* Landscape mobile */
@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.25rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
  .game-overlay .rounded-3xl {
    max-height: 95vh !important;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
  }
}

/* Safe area support (iPhone notch) */
@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Hide scrollbar on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .quiz-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar,
  .game-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
}</style><style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/ARScene.css">/* ============================================================
   LEARNAR – FULLSCREEN FIX
   Force break out of flexbox layout
   ============================================================ */

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 1: FORCE FULLSCREEN - BREAK FLEXBOX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Lock body */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: fixed !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force #root fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  /* top/right/bottom/left: 0 */
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break any flex/grid */
}

/* Force parent div (h-screen flex flex-col) to fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root>div {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break flex-col */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force main element fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) main {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Override flex-grow */
}

/* Hide Navbar when AR active */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) nav,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) header {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  /* Changed from #000 - iframe has video */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 9999 !important;
  /* Higher to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  /* Changed from #000 - iframe has video */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================

  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;

  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MOBILE RESPONSIVE
   ======================================================================== */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 10: SAFE AREA SUPPORT
   ======================================================================== */

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .learn-ar-container {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 11: AR CONTROL PANEL - PLAIN CSS (AR.JS COMPATIBLE)
   ======================================================================== */

/* Control panel - Plain CSS for AR.js compatibility */
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 1rem !important;
  right: 1rem !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Highest z-index to appear above everything */
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.5rem !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

.ar-control-buttons {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.25rem !important;

html, body, #root {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
:root {
  --color-honey: #F4D03F;
  --color-honey-dark: #D4AC0D;
  --color-sky: #5DADE2;
  --color-sky-dark: #2E86AB;
  --color-creamy: #FEF9E7;
  --color-success: #58D68D;
  --color-error: #EC7063;
  --color-warning: #F5B041;
  --color-text: #2C3E50;
  --color-text-light: #7F8C8D;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', system-ui, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  color-scheme: light dark;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87);
  background-color: #242424;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
.kid-theme {
  background-color: var(--color-creamy);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
a {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #646cff;
  text-decoration: inherit;
}
a:hover {
  color: #535bf2;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
body:not(:has(.learn-ar-container)) {
  display: flex;
  place-items: center;
}
h1 {
  font-size: 3.2em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  background-color: #1a1a1a;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.25s;
}
button:hover {
  border-color: #646cff;
}
button:focus, button:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root {
    color: #213547;
    background-color: #ffffff;
  }
  a:hover {
    color: #747bff;
  }
  button {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
  }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}
.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes gentleBounce {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}
.animate-gentleBounce {
  animation: gentleBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.5);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.8);
  }
}
.animate-pulseGlow {
  animation: pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-slideDown {
  animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
}
@keyframes breathe {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5);
  }
}
.animate-breathe {
  animation: breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bounce-slow {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(-5%);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(5%);
  }
}
.animate-bounce-slow {
  animation: bounce-slow 3s infinite ease-in-out;
}

### Planner Response

I see the issue! Looking at the HTML, the `.ar-container` has a `hidden` class applied to it:

```html
<div class="ar-container hidden" style="width: 100vw; height: 100vh; ...">
```

This is why the iframe isn't showing. Let me check the LearnAR component to see why:

### Planner Response

I see the ARContainer just uses `ar-container ${className}` - so the `hidden` class is coming from what's being passed as `className` prop. Let me check LearnAR.tsx to see where this is happening:

*Grep searched codebase*

*Grep searched codebase*

### Planner Response

Let me check the LearnAR page to see how ARContainer is being used:

*Viewed [LearnAR.tsx](file:///e:/Daniel%20Project/Graduted%20Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/pages/LearnAR.tsx) *

### Planner Response

Found it! Line 233 shows:
```jsx
className={appState === 'AR_ACTIVE' ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}
```

The problem is that `appState` is not `AR_ACTIVE` initially - it's probably `SCANNING_QR`. That's why the iframe is hidden. The ARContainer should always be visible, not conditional on the appState. Let me fix this:

*Edited relevant file*

.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MOBILE RESPONSIVE
   ======================================================================== */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 10: SAFE AREA SUPPORT
   ======================================================================== */

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .learn-ar-container {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 11: AR CONTROL PANEL - PLAIN CSS (AR.JS COMPATIBLE)
   ======================================================================== */

/* Control panel - Plain CSS for AR.js compatibility */
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 1rem !important;
  right: 1rem !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Highest z-index to appear above everything */
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.5rem !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

.ar-control-buttons {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.25rem !important;

html, body, #root {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
:root {
  --color-honey: #F4D03F;
  --color-honey-dark: #D4AC0D;
  --color-sky: #5DADE2;
  --color-sky-dark: #2E86AB;
  --color-creamy: #FEF9E7;
  --color-success: #58D68D;
  --color-error: #EC7063;
  --color-warning: #F5B041;
  --color-text: #2C3E50;
  --color-text-light: #7F8C8D;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', system-ui, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  color-scheme: light dark;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87);
  background-color: #242424;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
.kid-theme {
  background-color: var(--color-creamy);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
a {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #646cff;
  text-decoration: inherit;
}
a:hover {
  color: #535bf2;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
body:not(:has(.learn-ar-container)) {
  display: flex;
  place-items: center;
}
h1 {
  font-size: 3.2em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  background-color: #1a1a1a;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.25s;
}
button:hover {
  border-color: #646cff;
}
button:focus, button:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root {
    color: #213547;
    background-color: #ffffff;
  }
  a:hover {
    color: #747bff;
  }
  button {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
  }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}
.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes gentleBounce {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}
.animate-gentleBounce {
  animation: gentleBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.5);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.8);
  }
}
.animate-pulseGlow {
  animation: pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-slideDown {
  animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
}
@keyframes breathe {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5);
  }
}
.animate-breathe {
  animation: breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bounce-slow {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(-5%);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(5%);
  }
}
.animate-bounce-slow {
  animation: bounce-slow 3s infinite ease-in-out;
}

<style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/Overlays.css">/* ============================================================
   QUIZ & GAME RESPONSIVE OVERLAY
   Mobile-first design matching ARScene
   ============================================================ */

/* Base overlay container */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Content wrapper - responsive padding */
.quiz-overlay > div,
.game-overlay > div {
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

/* Card/Panel responsive sizing */
.quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.game-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.quiz-overlay .bg-white,
.game-overlay .bg-white {
  max-width: 90vw !important;
  max-height: 85vh !important;
  max-height: 85dvh !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Buttons responsive */
.quiz-overlay button,
.game-overlay button {
  min-height: 44px; /* iOS touch target */
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
}

/* Text responsive */
.quiz-overlay .text-xl,
.game-overlay .text-xl {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-2xl,
.game-overlay .text-2xl {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.5rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-6xl,
.game-overlay .text-6xl {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4rem);
}

/* Mobile optimizations */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* Game cards grid */
  .game-overlay .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }

  /* Game card sizing */
  .game-overlay .w-24,
  .game-overlay .h-24 {
    width: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
    height: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
  }

  /* Quiz options */
  .quiz-overlay .space-y-3 {
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }
}

/* Landscape mobile */
@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.25rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
  .game-overlay .rounded-3xl {
    max-height: 95vh !important;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
  }
}

/* Safe area support (iPhone notch) */
@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Hide scrollbar on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .quiz-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar,
  .game-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
}</style><style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/ARScene.css">/* ============================================================
   LEARNAR – FULLSCREEN FIX
   Force break out of flexbox layout
   ============================================================ */

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 1: FORCE FULLSCREEN - BREAK FLEXBOX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Lock body */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: fixed !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force #root fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  /* top/right/bottom/left: 0 */
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break any flex/grid */
}

/* Force parent div (h-screen flex flex-col) to fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root>div {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break flex-col */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force main element fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) main {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Override flex-grow */
}

/* Hide Navbar when AR active - CRITICAL for fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) nav,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) header,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) aside {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================

@media (max-width: 768px) {

  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}



/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MOBILE RESPONSIVE
   ======================================================================== */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 10: SAFE AREA SUPPORT
   ======================================================================== */

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .learn-ar-container {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 11: AR CONTROL PANEL - PLAIN CSS (AR.JS COMPATIBLE)
   ======================================================================== */

/* Control panel - Plain CSS for AR.js compatibility */
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 1rem !important;
  right: 1rem !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Highest z-index to appear above everything */
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.5rem !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

.ar-control-buttons {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.25rem !important;

html, body, #root {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
:root {
  --color-honey: #F4D03F;
  --color-honey-dark: #D4AC0D;
  --color-sky: #5DADE2;
  --color-sky-dark: #2E86AB;
  --color-creamy: #FEF9E7;
  --color-success: #58D68D;
  --color-error: #EC7063;
  --color-warning: #F5B041;
  --color-text: #2C3E50;
  --color-text-light: #7F8C8D;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', system-ui, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  color-scheme: light dark;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87);
  background-color: #242424;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
.kid-theme {
  background-color: var(--color-creamy);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
a {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #646cff;
  text-decoration: inherit;
}
a:hover {
  color: #535bf2;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
body:not(:has(.learn-ar-container)) {
  display: flex;
  place-items: center;
}
h1 {
  font-size: 3.2em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  background-color: #1a1a1a;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.25s;
}
button:hover {
  border-color: #646cff;
}
button:focus, button:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root {
    color: #213547;
    background-color: #ffffff;
  }
  a:hover {
    color: #747bff;
  }
  button {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
  }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}
.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes gentleBounce {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}
.animate-gentleBounce {
  animation: gentleBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.5);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.8);
  }
}
.animate-pulseGlow {
  animation: pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-slideDown {
  animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
}
@keyframes breathe {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5);
  }
}
.animate-breathe {
  animation: breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bounce-slow {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(-5%);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(5%);
  }
}
.animate-bounce-slow {
  animation: bounce-slow 3s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@property --tw-translate-x {
  syntax: "*";
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0;
}
@property --tw-translate-y {
  syntax: "*";
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0;

<style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/Overlays.css">/* ============================================================
   QUIZ & GAME RESPONSIVE OVERLAY
   Mobile-first design matching ARScene
   ============================================================ */

/* Base overlay container */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Content wrapper - responsive padding */
.quiz-overlay > div,
.game-overlay > div {
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

/* Card/Panel responsive sizing */
.quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.game-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.quiz-overlay .bg-white,
.game-overlay .bg-white {
  max-width: 90vw !important;
  max-height: 85vh !important;
  max-height: 85dvh !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Buttons responsive */
.quiz-overlay button,
.game-overlay button {
  min-height: 44px; /* iOS touch target */
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
}

/* Text responsive */
.quiz-overlay .text-xl,
.game-overlay .text-xl {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-2xl,
.game-overlay .text-2xl {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.5rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-6xl,
.game-overlay .text-6xl {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4rem);
}

/* Mobile optimizations */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* Game cards grid */
  .game-overlay .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }

  /* Game card sizing */
  .game-overlay .w-24,
  .game-overlay .h-24 {
    width: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
    height: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
  }

  /* Quiz options */
  .quiz-overlay .space-y-3 {
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }
}

/* Landscape mobile */
@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.25rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
  .game-overlay .rounded-3xl {
    max-height: 95vh !important;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
  }
}

/* Safe area support (iPhone notch) */
@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Hide scrollbar on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .quiz-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar,
  .game-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
}</style><style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/ARScene.css">/* ============================================================
   LEARNAR – FULLSCREEN FIX
   Force break out of flexbox layout
   ============================================================ */

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 1: FORCE FULLSCREEN - BREAK FLEXBOX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Lock body */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: fixed !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force #root fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  /* top/right/bottom/left: 0 */
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break any flex/grid */
}

/* Force parent div (h-screen flex flex-col) to fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root>div {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break flex-col */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force main element fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) main {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Override flex-grow */
}

/* Hide Navbar when AR active - CRITICAL for fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) nav,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) header,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) aside {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MOBILE RESPONSIVE
   ======================================================================== */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}



/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,
.ar-ui-overlay a,
.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Control panel */
.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1500 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Loading and error overlays */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 1800 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MOBILE RESPONSIVE
   ======================================================================== */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .ar-wrapper {
    position: fixed !important;
  }

  #arjs-video {
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    -o-object-fit: cover !important;
       object-fit: cover !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay {
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
  }

  .ar-ui-overlay button {
    padding: 0.5rem !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 10: SAFE AREA SUPPORT
   ======================================================================== */

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .learn-ar-container {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 11: AR CONTROL PANEL - PLAIN CSS (AR.JS COMPATIBLE)
   ======================================================================== */

/* Control panel - Plain CSS for AR.js compatibility */
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 1rem !important;
  right: 1rem !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Highest z-index to appear above everything */
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.5rem !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

.ar-control-buttons {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 0.25rem !important;

html, body, #root {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
:root {
  --color-honey: #F4D03F;
  --color-honey-dark: #D4AC0D;
  --color-sky: #5DADE2;
  --color-sky-dark: #2E86AB;
  --color-creamy: #FEF9E7;
  --color-success: #58D68D;
  --color-error: #EC7063;
  --color-warning: #F5B041;
  --color-text: #2C3E50;
  --color-text-light: #7F8C8D;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', system-ui, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  color-scheme: light dark;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.87);
  background-color: #242424;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
.kid-theme {
  background-color: var(--color-creamy);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
a {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #646cff;
  text-decoration: inherit;
}
a:hover {
  color: #535bf2;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
body:not(:has(.learn-ar-container)) {
  display: flex;
  place-items: center;
}
h1 {
  font-size: 3.2em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
button {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  background-color: #1a1a1a;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.25s;
}
button:hover {
  border-color: #646cff;
}
button:focus, button:focus-visible {
  outline: 4px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root {
    color: #213547;
    background-color: #ffffff;
  }
  a:hover {
    color: #747bff;
  }
  button {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
  }
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}
.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes gentleBounce {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}
.animate-gentleBounce {
  animation: gentleBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.5);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(93, 173, 226, 0.8);
  }
}
.animate-pulseGlow {
  animation: pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-10px);
  }
  to {

<style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/Overlays.css">/* ============================================================
   QUIZ & GAME RESPONSIVE OVERLAY
   Mobile-first design matching ARScene
   ============================================================ */

/* Base overlay container */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Content wrapper - responsive padding */
.quiz-overlay > div,
.game-overlay > div {
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

/* Card/Panel responsive sizing */
.quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.game-overlay .rounded-3xl,
.quiz-overlay .bg-white,
.game-overlay .bg-white {
  max-width: 90vw !important;
  max-height: 85vh !important;
  max-height: 85dvh !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* Buttons responsive */
.quiz-overlay button,
.game-overlay button {
  min-height: 44px; /* iOS touch target */
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
}

/* Text responsive */
.quiz-overlay .text-xl,
.game-overlay .text-xl {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-2xl,
.game-overlay .text-2xl {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.5rem);
}

.quiz-overlay .text-6xl,
.game-overlay .text-6xl {
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4rem);
}

/* Mobile optimizations */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* Game cards grid */
  .game-overlay .grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }

  /* Game card sizing */
  .game-overlay .w-24,
  .game-overlay .h-24 {
    width: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
    height: clamp(4rem, 20vw, 6rem) !important;
  }

  /* Quiz options */
  .quiz-overlay .space-y-3 {
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
  }
}

/* Landscape mobile */
@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .quiz-overlay > div,
  .game-overlay > div {
    padding: 0.25rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .quiz-overlay .rounded-3xl,
  .game-overlay .rounded-3xl {
    max-height: 95vh !important;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
  }
}

/* Safe area support (iPhone notch) */
@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
    padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
  }
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
.quiz-overlay,
.game-overlay {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Hide scrollbar on mobile */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .quiz-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar,
  .game-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .quiz-overlay,
  .game-overlay {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
}</style><style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="E:/Daniel Project/Graduted Project/Edu-platform/frontend-web/src/styles/ARScene.css">/* ============================================================
   LEARNAR – FULLSCREEN FIX
   Force break out of flexbox layout
   ============================================================ */

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 1: FORCE FULLSCREEN - BREAK FLEXBOX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Lock body */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: fixed !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force #root fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  /* top/right/bottom/left: 0 */
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break any flex/grid */
}

/* Force parent div (h-screen flex flex-col) to fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) #root>div {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Break flex-col */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Force main element fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) main {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: block !important;
  /* Override flex-grow */
}

/* Hide Navbar when AR active - CRITICAL for fullscreen */
body:has(.learn-ar-container) nav,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) header,
body:has(.learn-ar-container) aside {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 2: MAIN CONTAINER
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 4: VIDEO LAYER - Camera Feed
   ======================================================================== */

/* AR.js injects video to body */
body>#arjs-video,
#arjs-video {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 5: A-FRAME SCENE
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 6: CANVAS LAYER - AR Content (MUST BE TRANSPARENT)
   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container canvas,
.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,
.learn-ar-container a-scene canvas {
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7: UI OVERLAY - Top Layer (HIGHEST PRIORITY)
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-ui-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  /* Increased from 100 to 1000 */
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Enable clicks on interactive elements */
.ar-ui-overlay>*,
.ar-ui-overlay button,

.ar-ui-overlay input,
.ar-ui-overlay select,
.ar-ui-overlay [role="button"] {
  pointer-events: auto !important;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Ensure all child containers in overlay have proper stacking */
.ar-ui-overlay>div {
  position: relative;
  z-index: inherit;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 7.1: GAME & QUIZ OVERLAYS - CRITICAL Z-INDEX
   ======================================================================== */

/* Game overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .game-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="game"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Game"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Quiz overlay must be above everything */
.ar-ui-overlay .quiz-overlay,
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="quiz"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="Quiz"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 2000 !important;

}

.ar-ui-overlay .ar-control-panel,
.ar-control-panel {
  position: fixed !important;

}

.ar-ui-overlay [class*="loading"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="error"],
.ar-ui-overlay .absolute.inset-0 {
  position: fixed !important;

}

/* Status/debug overlay */
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="status"],
.ar-ui-overlay [class*="debug"] {
  z-index: 1900 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 8: HIDE A-FRAME UI
   ======================================================================== */

.a-inspector-button,
.arjs-loader,
.a-enter-vr-button,
.a-enter-ar-button {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

}

   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 99999 !important;
  /* Very high to cover sidebar */
}

/* ========================================================================
   SECTION 3: AR WRAPPER - Base Layer
   ======================================================================== */

.ar-wrapper {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #000 !important;
  /* Black - iframe video is inside iframe DOM */
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

   ======================================================================== */

  position: fixed !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100vh !important;
  height: 100dvh !important;
  -o-object-fit: cover !important;
     object-fit: cover !important;
  -o-object-position: center !important;
     object-position: center !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ========================================================================

   ======================================================================== */

.learn-ar-container a-scene {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.learn-ar-container .a-canvas,

  background: transparent !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}
